annotations.text:
Brand values lifted from segsolar.com stylesheets: red #E00700, dark red #B51B16, blue #1C5CB0, Kanit headings, square corners (the site uses 0 radius outside circular elements).
Data shown is live data from the prototype's store: 2 suppliers, real item codes and quotes, backend-calculated scores 79 and 94.

These three states are needed before the remaining backend rules land: blocking source roles until QC passes, and keeping voided records out of circulation.
Message text is copied from the API's own error strings.
